messages.subject: Imputation
parts:
Hi MSstats gurus's. Can someone explain the advantage of imputing data with MSstats? Does it make the statistical tests more sensitive? Is there a paper I can read that will help me understand imputation for this type of data?

Thanks!

Brett

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Imputation
parts:
Dear Brett,

We are preparing the manuscript about new approach of MSstats v3. In brief, imputation and TMP strategy in MSstats is more sensitive across several datasets. I attach one of results, with iPRG 2015 data. More details will be described in the manuscript. The paper, A statistical framework for protein quantitation in bottom-up MS-based proteomics, Y Karpievitch et al. Bioinformatics 2009, which addressed the imputation method, might be helpful even though the method of imputation in MSstats is different somehow.

Hope to help.

Sincerely,
- Meena
